description: Fetch and parse an XML sitemap or sitemap index from a public HTTPS URL (or paste raw XML). SSRF-protected: refuses private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata addresses, re-validates redirects. Optional recursive expansion of sub-sitemaps. Returns lastmod, changefreq, priority when present.

xml.description: Paste raw XML instead of fetching by URL.

name: sitemap_extract
